description: This PHP source file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Request_Stdin, which extends Zend_XmlRpc_Request. Its purpose is to read an XML-RPC request from standard input (STDIN), process it, and provide access to the raw XML data. It also handles potential errors in opening STDIN or reading the XML data.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Request_Stdin
classes.description: A class to handle XML-RPC requests received via STDIN, extending Zend_XmlRpc_Request and adding functionality to read raw request data from standard input.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that reads XML data from php://stdin, handles errors if STDIN cannot be opened, and initializes the request by parsing the XML.

methods.name: getRawRequest
methods.description: Returns the raw XML content that was read from STDIN.
